title: Working Dog Commemorative Coin Act
official_summary:
Working Dog Commemorative Coin Act

This act directs the Department of the Treasury to mint and issue 50,000 $5 gold coins, 500,000 $1 silver coins, and 750,000 half-dollar clad coins in commemoration of the service that working dogs provide to society.

The designs of the coins minted under this act shall be emblematic of the contributions of working dogs to society, including in detection, military service, therapy, and assistance.

Treasury may issue coins only during the one-year period beginning on January 1, 2027.

All sales of coins shall include a surcharge, which shall be paid to America's VetDogs for general expenses associated with the fulfillment of its mission.

summary.headline: A 2024 law directs the Treasury to mint commemorative coins honoring working dogs, with part of each sale going to America's VetDogs.
summary.what_it_does: The law tells the Treasury Department to mint 50,000 $5 gold coins, 500,000 $1 silver coins, and 750,000 half-dollar clad coins. The coin designs must reflect working dogs' roles in detection, military service, therapy, and assistance. Coins may only be issued during the one-year period beginning January 1, 2027, and every sale must include a surcharge paid to America's VetDogs.

who_it_affects.group: People who buy the commemorative coins
who_it_affects.how: They can purchase these coins, and each sale includes a surcharge on top of the coin's price.
The charity receives the surcharge money from coin sales to pay for general expenses of its mission.
They gain access to a limited run of coins with designs honoring working dogs, available only during 2027.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The act became law on November 25, 2024, but coins may only be issued from January 1, 2027, through December 31, 2027.
